name: card
description: A static card: a printed heading, one or more paragraphs in the product's voice, and an optional row of actions. Human-written, never generated; never colour-coded, never alarming. Today it carries the delete-everything confirmation inside the dialog.

level.description: Heading level. h3 under a page's section heading; h2 when the card carries the first heading on the page (revision 48).

title.description: The heading, final copy. Set in printed caps by the CSS.

titleId.description: id for the heading, so a dialog can point aria-labelledby at it.

paragraphs.description: The body, one string per paragraph, in order. An item may be { text, status: true }: an outcome line read out once (role="status"), as in the failed-delete state. It looks exactly like the other paragraphs.

actions.description: The row of actions at the foot of the card.

exposes.--aj-c-card-measure: Paragraph measure below a 700px container. Default 38ch.
exposes.--aj-c-card-measure-wide: Paragraph measure from a 700px container up. Default none (the card fills its container); the dialog sets 38ch (revision 26).

states.hover: n/a: the card is static; its actions carry their own states
states.focus-visible: n/a: the card is not focusable; its actions are
states.error: yes: a status paragraph states the failure in words (paragraphs item with status: true), never in colour
states.empty: n/a: a card without a title and a paragraph is not rendered

a11y.role: none of its own; the heading names it, and a dialog labels itself with titleId
a11y.keyboard: none of its own; actions are links or buttons in tab order

responsive.700: paragraphs lose their 38ch measure and fill the card (--aj-c-card-measure-wide), revision 25

changelog.change: The actions slot takes button modules (the button module exists); fixtures use them.
